headline: A unified financial ecosystem, activated only with evidence
lead: EnteleKRON's earlier aims, products, ENK tokenomics, and Ethereum-secured L2 direction remain unchanged. The financial layer adds a separately governed stablecoin, minting, treasury, custody, payments, institutional services, and tokenization architecture.

components.name: TVKUSD
components.copy: A separate fiat-backed liability with issuer, reserve, redemption, ledger, audit, and jurisdiction gates. It does not replace ENK.

components.name: EnteleMINT
components.copy: Evidence-gated issuance and burn controls. No payment request or UI action can mint value.

components.name: EnteleTREASURY
components.copy: Separate reserve-liability, operating-capital, corporate-treasury, ENK-treasury, and collateral books.

components.name: Custody and payments
components.copy: Canonical-asset verification, customer-asset segregation, and exact product/activity/entity/country activation.

components.name: Prime brokerage
components.copy: Execution, custody, financing, collateral, settlement, and reporting are separately approved services—not one global permission.

components.name: Tokenization
components.copy: Legal rights and issuer evidence must exist before an on-chain representation is created.

invariants: ENK remains the ecosystem access, governance, and network-utility asset with a fixed maximum supply of 100 billion.
TVKUSD never counts toward ENK supply, allocations, sale inventory, or reserves.
No EnteleKRON entity is described as a bank or licensed everywhere without exact, dated evidence.
A roadmap capability is not presented as live.
Türkiye crypto-payment routes remain disabled under the current baseline.
legal: Forward-looking architecture. Not an offer, deposit, bank account, payment service, custody service, investment service, or representation of current licensing.
